scenario: A plan expects that attaching an SCP to the workload OU will grant access to a service; SCPs limit permissions and never grant them, so the plan must be corrected and the misunderstanding reported, never executed as written.

plan.step: attach an SCP allowing service X to the workload OU
plan.expectation: the workload role gains access to service X

account_state.identity_policy: no allow for service X on the workload role

when: the plan is assessed before apply

reasons: the SCP is reported as a guardrail that caps permissions; the grant must come from an identity or resource policy inside the account
the corrected plan adds a scoped identity-policy allow for the workload role and keeps (or tightens) the SCP as the limit
the correction is previewed as exact policy JSON with the affected principals named
must_not: attach the SCP and expect access to appear
describe the SCP as a grant mechanism anywhere in the recommendation or its explanation
widen the identity policy beyond the specific actions and resources the workload needs
